# Splashplay

> Splashplay is a creative art studio in Barcelona offering unconventional painting experiences. This site allows visitors to learn about techniques, book sessions, and purchase gift cards. The platform supports Spanish, English, and Catalan.

## About

Splashplay is a messy-play art studio in Barcelona, specializing in unconventional creative experiences like rage painting and pouring. Visitors use non-traditional techniques like pouring, spinning, boxing with paint, balloons, water guns, and dripping (Pollock-style) to create unique artwork.

Sessions are available for couples, families, friend groups, and individuals. The studio also hosts celebrations including birthday parties and special occasions.

Team-building events are available for groups of up to 10 people, tailored to the specific needs of companies. These sessions offer a unique way to strengthen team bonds through creative collaboration and stress-relieving activities.

Splashplay is also a private extreme painting experience for teams, companies, and groups looking for an original alternative to bowling, karaoke, laser tag, sip and paint, or escape rooms. Participants create real artworks together using paint-throwing techniques and unexpected tools such as boxing gloves, water guns, tennis balls, balloons, pouring, spinning, and dripping. No artistic experience is required.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://splashplay.es/): Main landing page with techniques showcase, testimonials, pricing, and gallery
- [Couples](https://splashplay.es/couples): Romantic painting experience for two (€60-90, 1.5 hours)
- [Families](https://splashplay.es/family): Family-friendly sessions with children (from €17 per person, 45 min - 1.5 hours)
- [Friends](https://splashplay.es/friends): Group sessions for 2-6 people (from €17 per person, 45 min - 1.5 hours)
- [Corporate](https://splashplay.es/corporate): Team-building and private company events for groups
- [Gift Cards](https://splashplay.es/giftcard): Purchase gift cards for any experience

## Contact

- [Contact](https://splashplay.es/#contact): Contact Splashplay to ask questions, get directions, or discuss private and corporate sessions
- Address: Concili de Trento, 7, Barcelona
- Location: El Clot, near El Clot (L1, L2) and Glòries (L1) metro stations
